purpose: Inspect a selected vehicle's current battery certificate, its reported and reconstructed evidence, provenance boundaries, verification result, and canonical JSON download.
primaryGoal: Understand exactly what the current server certificate says and what its digest does and does not protect, without treating proxies as calibrated health, causality, safety, warranty, or remaining-life claims.

dataSources.owner: Battery Passport API hook; batteryPassportHandler.Get registered in internal\api\router.go:3352
dataSources.behavior: Key ['battery-passport', vehicleId]; enabled only with non-null selected ID; ANALYTICS stale time; forwards AbortSignal; returns raw snake_case certificate facts.
dataSources.limits: Route registration confirmed, not server response execution. Router comments at 3345-3351 describe a best-effort ledger append during certificate reads; no request was issued.

dataSources.owner: Battery Passport API hook; batteryPassportHandler.Verify registered in internal\api\router.go:3353
dataSources.behavior: Key ['battery-passport-verify', vehicleId, hash]; disabled until ID and nonempty digest exist; ANALYTICS stale time; forwards AbortSignal; failure does not discard certificate.
dataSources.limits: Digest agreement is not upstream evidence validation. Backend recomputation and hash algorithm were not executed or independently audited.

Certificate snapshot and UTC trend are not a range-filtered analysis endpoint.
dataSources.limits: Nested fleet request implementation was not inspected. Header/mobile picker operation remains unverified.

dataSources.owner: Existing shared trust, timezone, saved numeric preferences and operational metric formatting
dataSources.behavior: Fatal and refresh failures separated; identity instants use vehicle timezone; trend uses UTC day keys; one mount clock and memoized analyzeBatteryPassport result drive all sections.
dataSources.limits: Only trust adapter and its contract were inspected directly; nested settings/timezone queries and locale catalogs were not audited.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep a single small battery-domain presentation descriptor for existing verification statuses; retain section-specific layout and separate expected/provided hash evidence. Do not create an app-wide competing status registry.

sourceEvidence: Masthead.tsx:151-175 wraps title/actions; identity stacks until lg, hashes break-all (223,322-330).
CapacityContext.tsx:37 and UsageProfile.tsx:37 use md three-column grids inside half-width CardGrid placements. Allocated card width, not viewport alone, needs verification.

Methodology.tsx:181 uses md two columns and xl four without removing its twelve disclosures.

issues.detail: mobileColumns keeps only field/value/binding, no mobilePresentation or expanded detail is supplied, and columnVisibility is disabled at 331. DataTable.tsx:725 applies hidden md:table-cell to source. Thus the source-and-meaning evidence has no page-provided mobile access path below md.
issues.fix: Reuse the field directory's existing DataTable keyValue mobile contract with source as meta and binding as badge, or retain all columns with contained scroll. Preserve every source explanation and the existing table ID/order.

sourceEvidence: TrendTimeline.tsx:79-88 supplies chart name, description and dataColumns.
SectionBody.tsx:79-85 supplies role=status and localized loading name.
Masthead status icons and most decorative section icons have aria-hidden; actions use shared Button/CopyButton.
FadeIn.tsx:24-36 uses shared reduced-motion preference; OS behavior was not exercised.

issues.detail: The prominent reported grade is aria-hidden and uses an ad-hoc text-5xl/font-bold span. Its caption only identifies the metric, not the hidden value. Grade is available later in KPI/audit sections, so this is a local identity-summary omission, not total loss from the page.
issues.fix: Use existing MetricValue/Text roles and expose a localized Certificate-reported grade plus actual grade within this masthead; preserve independent verification status and grade semantics.

issues.detail: Unknown or invalid thermal shares are converted to 0 before MetricBar. Distribution.tsx:78 similarly converts null share to 0. The shared MetricBar then sets aria-valuenow=0 even when sublabel says an em dash; visible and assistive trust semantics disagree.
issues.fix: Pass band.valuePct directly and bin.share == null ? null : bin.share * 100. Reuse current nullable MetricBar API, retaining true measured zero, labels, counts, exact unnormalized sums and invalid/no-data explanations.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, focus, touch targets, screen reader, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced motion unverified. Token names and source ARIA are not acceptance.

states.loading: Both hooks remain mounted; null inputs disable requests. Initial certificate loading is local to shells. Methodology remains independent.
states.empty: Resolved null remains distinct from undefined; export disabled; domain interiors describe absent certificate. Recommendations and thermal sections have source-specific empty/invalid descriptions.
states.error: Only masthead owns initial certificate retry. Retained certificate survives refresh error. Verification error remains nonblocking; cached verify payload is retained.
states.partial: Sanitized diagnostic fields remain nullable; grade mismatch remains separate; invalid thermal and trend accounting are described rather than silently reconciled.
states.offline: Shared trust adapter knows paused queries but the page's narrowed state drops that information.

issues.detail: queryState forwards fatalError/refreshError but drops passportSource.status, isRefreshBlocked, isRefreshing and updatedAt. With retained data and fetchStatus=paused, useDataState knows the source is stale/offline; masthead only warns on refreshError and BatteryEvidenceBrief only marks retained on refreshError (KpiBand.tsx:93). It can continue labeling cached data Available source readings. With no data and a paused first fetch, no local offline recovery reason is supplied.
issues.fix: Carry the existing DataState alongside the domain selection/resolution state. Reuse nonblocking StaleRefreshWarning/DataStateNotice for retained offline/refresh state and shared initial offline notice for paused-first-load; preserve all shells, initial masthead retry ownership, cached facts, query keys and enablement.

issues.detail: No vehicle, fatal certificate failure, unresolved certificate, null certificate and zero qualifying trend points all feed the chart's same empty flag. Unlike SectionBody, this chart does not supply a source-specific empty explanation.
issues.fix: Reuse existing chart emptyContent/emptyMessage capability or a domain passive explanation to distinguish these causes; maintain the chart shell, UTC series/data table and sole masthead initial retry.

visualIssues.detail: A green/cyan/purple saturated gradient stripe decorates certificate identity independent of state. Repeated cyan section action icons (CapacityContext.tsx:35, Methodology.tsx:180-187) compete with actual verification meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Remove the decorative stripe or use a neutral existing border token; neutralize ordinary section icons and keep muted semantic hue only on actual verification/grade distinctions. Preserve saved theme choices and all sections.

visualIssues.detail: Timeline and distribution use fixed electric cyan #22d3ee (Distribution.tsx:80); thermalColor defines fixed blue/green/red hex at ThermalProfile.tsx:53-57. Bars default to shared gradient fill. These bypass the canonical palette and are not proof of light-theme contrast.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing canonical chart/semantic palette references and MetricBar fill='solid'. Preserve cold/nominal/hot categories and textual labels, chart user preferences, series, tooltip formats and actual values; do not introduce a new palette.

visualIssues.detail: Six adjacent diagnostic MetricCards select cyan/amber/purple/blue/green/red for formula inputs and both grades; CapacityContext.tsx:55,78,93 and UsageProfile.tsx:51,66,81 similarly color neutral rollups differently. The source encodes categorical color without demonstrating meaningful distinctions.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the operational metrics pipeline for neutral numeric groups where specialist formatter parity is proven; retain every metric, subtitle, source formula, mismatch notice and display preference. Keep unsupported specialist fields rather than deleting them to fit generic stats.

architectureIssues.detail: toBatteryPassportCertificate says values are copied without diagnostic reinterpretation, but degradation_trend.flatMap discards nonobjects, invalid UTC dates and out-of-range/nonfinite SoH at 845-854. A downloaded certificate can omit exactly the malformed evidence reported by trend diagnostics while retaining the original provenance hash. This is a source-confirmed conditional loss, not an executed export failure.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep canonical snake_case export distinct from sanitized display analysis; preserve original trend fact ordering and anomalous facts or explicitly identify a separately named sanitized export. Establish behavior for malformed objects and unknown fields without reintroducing camelCase convenience mirrors or inventing measurements.

architectureIssues.detail: Current typed wire shape still declares capacity_kwh and original_capacity_kwh; analysis uses 0..500 kWh validation (batteryPassportAnalysis.ts:618-623) and presentation/export bind those exact names. This is an inherited contract conflict with the canonical SI mandate, not permission for a page-only rename or assumed multiplication.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must inspect actual backend JSON, canonical OpenAPI and tsbp-v1 hash/ledger migration before any coordinated wire change. Preserve current bytes, export keys, precision and hash-bound facts until that contract is proven. Modernization must not guess that existing values are Wh or secretly rescale them.
